Bounded.description: Both members may match, and the first bounds its strings: ["a", "b"] matches neither, which no type says.

Apart.description: contains in members of two applicators: [1] matches the anyOf member's type, but not its contains, which no type says.

Nested.description: contains in a member of a member: [1] matches the outer member's type, but not the inner contains, which no type says; the other member's contains is typed.

Conditional.description: contains in then, which applies where if admits the value, and in an anyOf member: [1, 2] has the two items if asks for and not the string then asks for, which no type says.

BesidePrefix.description: The prefix item is evaluated without the member: [1] matches the member's type, but not its contains, which no type says.

OnlyMember.description: The one member's contains alone evaluates every item where it matches, which it must: two strings at least.

PrefixedMember.description: [1] matches the first member's type but not its contains, and no member matches, which no type says; where the second does not match, the first evaluates the same: its contains is typed.

BesideOwn.description: contains of the schema and of a member: which items match each no type says.
